verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows generic marketing language that JumpCloud enforces SSO/MFA 'across all SAML and OIDC-based apps,' implying custom app support, but there are no documented walkthroughs for adding a custom SAML/OIDC connector, and header-based apps are never mentioned at all. missing for 10: step-by-step docs for configuring a custom SAML app, custom OIDC app setup guide, any mention of header-based SSO support, independent confirmation of these workflows.
